seo_title: Food Tours in Kuala Lumpur & Penang | Simply Enak
seo_description: Small-group food tours in Kuala Lumpur and Penang. Browse by city, diet, or travel style. Local guides since 2011. From RM 285 per person.
hero_subtitle: For 14 years, we've been introducing guests to Aunty Lim's 40-year-old laksa stall, Pak Hassan's family roti recipe, and the hidden lanes where Kuala Lumpur's food legend was written
hero_description: Your temporary neighbours in Malaysia. For 14+ years, we've been walking guests through neighbourhoods where we grew up eating, introducing them to vendors who've become family, and sharing the Malaysia we treasure. Not tourist food. The real thing. Where would you like to start?
signature_tours_subtext: The 5 tours that started it all. Each one built around vendors we've known for over a decade — the aunties and uncles who've become our extended family.
tours_by_city_subtext: Every Malaysian city tells a different food story. Penang's Chinese grandmothers, KL's Malay kampung traditions, Melaka's 600-year Peranakan fusion. Choose your chapter.
dietary_subtext: Malaysia has deep Buddhist and Hindu vegetarian traditions, halal hawker culture, and generations of adaptation. Every diet has a rich culinary heritage here.
specialty_subtext: Each specialty tour dives into a distinct culinary tradition with expert depth.
travel_style_subtext: Every traveller is different. Whether you're with family or on your own, we have the right experience for you.
custom_group_subtext: Whether you're celebrating, team-building, or traveling with family, we'll design a tour that fits your group, your pace, and your interests.
social_proof_subtext: Here's what travelers from around the world experienced.
why_us_description: Your temporary neighbours in Malaysia. For over 14 years, we've been sharing the places and flavours we grew up eating, introducing guests to vendors who've become family, and revealing the stories behind every dish. Come as a guest, leave as a friend who sees, feels, and can taste the difference between tourist Malaysia and the Malaysia we treasure.

fallback_faqs.question: How do I decide which tour is right for me?
fallback_faqs.answer: Start with location—which city interests you? Then consider your dietary needs and group type. If you're solo or a couple, join our regular tours. Families and groups of 6+ benefit from custom experiences. Still unsure? Contact us—we love helping people find their perfect Malaysian food experience.

fallback_faqs.question: What if I have dietary restrictions?
fallback_faqs.answer: Every tour can be adapted. Vegetarian, vegan, halal, gluten-free, allergies—just tell us when booking. Our dedicated vegetarian heritage tours cover Malaysia's 140-year plant-based tradition. For other dietary needs, we work with vendors who can accommodate while maintaining local flavours.
